items.name: Bread
items.desc: A heel of dark bread. Filling.

items.name: Smoked fish
items.desc: Salty, oily and good.

items.name: Mussels
items.desc: Prised off the rocks.

items.name: Blackberries
items.desc: Sharp and sweet.

items.name: Flint and steel
items.desc: A tinderbox from the wreck, the flint and steel still dry inside. For lighting fires.

items.name: Green gem
items.desc: A small green stone, clear as bottle glass. A smith could set it in something.

items.name: Crab meat
items.desc: Sweet white meat, cracked out of the shell.

items.name: Field mushrooms
items.desc: Pale caps from the woods. You're fairly sure they're the safe kind.

items.name: Hazelnuts
items.desc: A pocketful, cracked with a stone.

items.name: Samphire
items.desc: Salty green stems from the marsh edge.

items.name: Yenson's bucket
items.desc: A wooden bucket, bound with rope. Empty.

items.name: Bucket of water
items.desc: Spring water for Yenson's pot. Heavy.

items.name: Deadwood
items.desc: An armful of dry fallen branches.

items.name: Roast boar
items.desc: Boar meat, cooked over your own fire. Dark and rich.

items.name: Hare
items.desc: A snared hare, for the hunters' larder. You could cook it yourself, at a pinch.

items.name: Split wood
items.desc: Logs split for the lodge's smokehouse.

items.name: Empty pail
items.desc: The lodge's pail, for fetching water from the stream.

items.name: Pail of stream water
items.desc: Cold stream water. Boil it before you drink it.

items.name: Iron ore
items.desc: Rusty lumps of ore from the old quarry. Garran can smelt it.

items.name: Garran's pick
items.desc: An old pick with a new handle. Garran wants it back.

items.name: Pack leader's pelt
items.desc: A huge grey pelt, black along the spine. Proof, if anyone doubts you.

items.name: Bandage
items.desc: A roll of clean linen. Stops bleeding, binds sprains and ribs.

items.name: Flask of spirits
items.desc: Rough fishermen's spirit. Burns going into a wound, which is the point.

items.name: Splint
items.desc: Two straight lengths of wood and some ties, for a broken bone.

items.name: Sewing kit
items.desc: Needle and waxed thread. For deep cuts, if you can stomach it. It isn't used up.

items.name: Yarrow
items.desc: A hill herb with feathery leaves. Packed into a wound, it stops it going bad.

items.name: Health potion
items.desc: A little stoppered bottle of something red and bitter. Gives back 40 health at once, even in a fight. It heals; it can't bring round someone who's down.

items.name: Willow bark
items.desc: Chewed or brewed, it brings a fever down.

items.name: Raw boar meat
items.desc: Fresh off the bone. Cook it on a fire before you eat it.

items.name: Boar hide
items.desc: A whole hide, bristly and heavy. Scraped, smoked and cut, it makes good leather.

items.name: Sinew
items.desc: Boar sinew, dried and twisted. It makes a bowstring.

items.name: Ash stave
items.desc: A straight length of young ash, split and shaved. The makings of a bow.

items.name: Gull egg
items.desc: Small, speckled and still warm. Raw, but it's food.

enemies.name: Yellow-eyed wolf
enemies.desc: A starved grey wolf, all ribs and matted fur. Its eyes have gone the colour of old pus, and it doesn't blink.

moves.name: snaps at you
moves.tell: It circles you, snapping at the air.

moves.name: lunges at your throat
moves.tell: It drops low and its back legs bunch. It's going to lunge.

moves.name: backs off, hackles up
moves.tell: It backs off a step, watching your hands. It's ready for you.

enemies.name: Rock crab
enemies.desc: A crab the size of a dinner plate, barnacled and old. One claw is far bigger than the other, and there's a yellow crust where its eyes should shine.

moves.name: pinches at your ankle
moves.tell: It sidles towards you, big claw open.

moves.name: clamps its big claw on you
moves.tell: It rears up and raises both claws high.

moves.name: hunkers down behind its shell
moves.tell: It pulls its legs in and hunkers behind its shell.

enemies.name: Wild boar
enemies.desc: A bristle-backed boar as heavy as a man, with tusks like hooks. It's been rooting round the spring for weeks and has stopped being afraid of anyone.

moves.name: hooks at you with its tusks
moves.tell: It swings its head low, tusks first.

moves.name: charges you down
moves.tell: It paws the ground and drops its head. It's going to charge.

moves.name: stamps and snorts
moves.tell: It backs off a step, snorting, watching you.

enemies.name: The pack leader
enemies.desc: The biggest wolf you've ever seen, grey going black along the spine, with an old scar across its muzzle. Its eyes burn yellow, and the other wolves won't come near it.

moves.name: mauls you
moves.tell: It paces towards you, head low, jaws open.

moves.name: lunges at your throat
moves.tell: It drops low and its back legs bunch. It's going to lunge.

moves.name: snaps at you mid-lunge
moves.tell: It drops low, but its weight stays on its front paws.

moves.name: throws back its head and howls
moves.tell: It stops and fills its chest. The air goes still. It's about to howl.

moves.name: tears into you in a frenzy
moves.tell: Its hackles rise and froth flecks its jaws. It's about to go wild.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.desc: You served in the King's levy until the pay stopped coming. You've been hurt before, and you don't stay down.
backgrounds.perkDesc: Below 30% health, your blows land 30% harder.

backgrounds.name: Thief
backgrounds.desc: You lived by quick hands in the back streets of Zaron, until the watch learned your face.
backgrounds.perkDesc: Dodging costs half the stamina, and it's easier to time.

backgrounds.name: Hunter
backgrounds.desc: You tracked deer through the northern woods. You know where a blow does the most harm.
backgrounds.perkDesc: 12% more chance of a critical hit.

backgrounds.name: Farmer
backgrounds.desc: Years in the fields, in all weathers. When the harvest failed you went looking for work.
backgrounds.perkDesc: Hunger and thirst drain 20% slower, and rain and cold get to you 40% slower.

backgrounds.name: Herbalist
backgrounds.desc: An old wise-woman taught you which plants heal and which ones kill.
backgrounds.perkDesc: Your wounds heal 50% faster, and treating any wound takes half the time.

backgrounds.name: Scholar
backgrounds.desc: You copied books in a lord's library and picked up a little of everything.
backgrounds.perkDesc: Your stats and skills grow 20% faster.

gear.name: Gutting knife
gear.desc: A sailor's knife from the wreck. Made for gutting fish, not fights, but it has a point.

gear.name: Iron knife
gear.desc: Plain and sharp, and you made it.

gear.name: Hide buckler
gear.desc: A small round shield of boiled hide on an iron rim.

gear.name: Reinforced work gloves
gear.desc: Leather with iron studs across the knuckles.

gear.name: Salt-stiff shirt
gear.desc: Your own shirt, stiff with dried seawater and torn at one sleeve.

gear.name: Torn trousers
gear.desc: Good cloth once. The sea and the rocks have had their way with them.

gear.name: Salt-stained boots
gear.desc: They squelch less than they did, which is something.

gear.name: Iron cap
gear.desc: A plain round cap of hammered iron. It won't stop much, but it'll stop something.

gear.name: Leather jerkin
gear.desc: Thick, laced leather that turns a claw or a glancing blade.

gear.name: Leather boots
gear.desc: Tall boots of oiled leather. Dry feet, steady footing.

gear.name: Bone charm
gear.desc: A carved bone on a leather cord. Fishermen here wear them against the sea.

gear.name: Copper ring
gear.desc: A plain copper band, gone green at the edges.

gear.name: Woodcutter's axe
gear.desc: A long-hafted axe made for felling trees. It takes both hands, and it hits like it.

gear.name: Hunting bow
gear.desc: Rook's old bow, ash and sinew, worn smooth where the hand goes. It takes both hands.

gear.name: Hunting dagger
gear.desc: Ida's gift: a broad-bladed hunter's dagger in a worn sheath. Short, sharp and honest.

traits.name: Balanced
traits.desc: Sits well in the hand. The timing bar's sweet spot is wider.

traits.name: Warded
traits.desc: Old folk say it keeps bad luck off you. Maybe it does.

traits.name: Kindled
traits.desc: Every hit carries a little fire.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.desc: Blocks a little more of every hit.

traits.name: Swift
traits.desc: Helps you act before your enemy.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.desc: More stamina to work and fight with.

materials.name: Green gem
materials.desc: Your green quarry gem is set in the {part}.

spells.name: Draw Water
spells.desc: Pull water out of the air. Refills your waterskin; puts out small fires.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.desc: A spark of fire. Lights fires, and stings in a fight.

journal.text: Follow the coast road north to Skelmed. Yenson says what's left of your boat washed up on the beach just north of his shack: there may be something there worth taking.
Ida drove the wolf off you on the road. Get into Skelmed and have the bite seen to.
Ask Ida at the hunters' lodge how you can help.
Rook is waiting at Skelmed's north gate to set out for Eastmere. (Eastmere and the road to it open in the next part of the game.)
Rook is walking with you to Eastmere, where Ida's sent him to find help for Skelmed.

objects.text: North: Skelmed. South: Yenson. Mind the tide.
SKELMED. Nets, rope, fish. Mind the dogs. The word "dogs" has been scratched out and "wolves" written over it.
Boarded up. Someone has chalked on the door: GONE INLAND.
Boarded up, a cold forge behind the shutters. The smith went inland with the rest. Somebody has nailed a horseshoe over the door, upside down, so the luck runs out.
The noticeboard. One notice, months old: BY ORDER OF THE CROWN, THE HARBOUR LEVY IS RAISED TO ONE HALF.
Left: SNARES, KEEP OFF. (Rook) Someone has scratched a wolf's head underneath, and a cross through it.

quests.name: Wood and meat
quests.desc: Ida has sent you up into the forest above Skelmed with her son Rook, to gather deadwood for the village and hunt the boar that's been rooting up the garden. Take it all back to her at the lodge.

goals.text: Gather three bundles of deadwood in the forest

quests.name: The road to Eastmere
quests.desc: "Things are getting worse around here. If we don't get help soon, this village is done for." Ida is sending Rook to Eastmere, the nearest town, to find someone who'll help Skelmed, and you're going with him.

goals.text: Set out with Rook through Skelmed's north gate

quests.name: The pack leader
quests.desc: The yellow-eyed wolves have a leader: a huge grey brute with a scarred muzzle, denning in the north-east of the forest above Skelmed. Ida wants it dead, and she's sent Rook with you.

goals.text: Find the den in the north-east of the forest, with Rook

skills.name: Fists
skills.desc: Fighting with nothing in your hands.

skills.name: Daggers
skills.desc: Knives and daggers: quick, close and light on stamina.

skills.name: Axes
skills.desc: Heavy, slow swings that hit like a falling tree.

skills.name: Bows
skills.desc: Shooting from a distance. Hard to learn, hard to stop.

skills.name: Shields
skills.desc: Blocking and parrying with a shield in your off hand.

skills.name: Magic
skills.desc: Casting spells. Makes every spell hit harder.

skills.name: Mining
skills.desc: Digging ore and stone. Each level makes the work lighter.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.desc: Working the forge. Each level adds 3 to the quality of what you make, and makes the work lighter.

skills.name: Woodcutting
skills.desc: Gathering and splitting wood. Each level makes the work lighter.

skills.name: Hunting
skills.desc: Snares, tracking and game. Each level makes the work lighter.

skills.name: First aid
skills.desc: Grows each time you treat a wound. Every level heals your whole party faster.

skills.name: Survival
skills.desc: Fires, shelter and clean water. Each level makes the work lighter.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.desc: Cooking over a fire. Each level makes the work lighter.

skills.name: Crafting
skills.desc: Making your own gear: bows, leather, tools. Each level makes the work lighter.

moves.name: Haymaker
moves.desc: A wild, swinging punch: hard, but tiring.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.desc: Crude, but it rattles them: the enemy loses its next action.

moves.name: Quick stab
moves.desc: A fast jab that always strikes before the enemy.

moves.name: Pinning shot
moves.desc: An arrow through the paw: the enemy loses its next action.

moves.name: Shield bash
moves.desc: Slam them with the shield: the enemy loses its next action.

moves.name: Rim strike
moves.desc: Drive the shield's rim through their guard.

moves.name: Flare
moves.desc: Kindle pushed as far as it goes: a burst of fire.

followers.name: Rook
followers.desc: One of Ida's hunters. Young, quiet, and a better shot than he lets on.
followers.until: Ida's sent him to Eastmere to find help for Skelmed, and you're walking with him. After that he goes his own way.
followers.traitDesc: Grew up in these hills, living off very little. He eats and drinks half what anyone else does, so he's cheap to keep on a long road.

abilities.name: Aimed shot
abilities.desc: Every third round he takes his time over a shot: it hits 50% harder and goes straight through a guard.

abilities.name: Pin down
abilities.desc: Once a fight, when the enemy gathers itself for a big attack, he pins it with an arrow before it can spring.

abilities.name: Field dressing
abilities.desc: After a fight he binds the worst bleeding wound in the party, yours included, without using your linen.

afflictions.name: Bite wound
afflictions.desc: Teeth went in. It bleeds, and an animal's mouth is filthy: clean it before it goes bad.

afflictions.name: Cut
afflictions.desc: A shallow cut. It bleeds until it's bound.

afflictions.name: Deep gash
afflictions.desc: Laid open. It bleeds hard and needs cleaning, stitching and binding.

afflictions.name: Broken arm
afflictions.desc: Every swing is agony. Set it in a splint and give it days.

afflictions.name: Broken leg
afflictions.desc: You can't run, can't get away from a fight, and the whole party crawls. Splint it and give it days.

afflictions.name: Cracked ribs
afflictions.desc: Every breath hurts. Bind them and you can at least breathe.

afflictions.name: Sprained ankle
afflictions.desc: Swollen and weak. No running until it's bound and rested.

afflictions.name: Concussion
afflictions.desc: Your head rings and the world swims. Blows go astray. Only sleep fixes it.

afflictions.name: Infection
afflictions.desc: The wound's gone hot and angry and the fever's in you. It'll kill you slowly unless you bring the fever down.

afflictions.name: Chill
afflictions.desc: You slept cold and wet and now you've caught it: shivers, a running nose, no strength. A warm bed and time.

afflictions.name: Hypothermia
afflictions.desc: Too cold for too long. Clumsy, slow, and it's killing you. Get dry and get warm: a fire, a bed, a roof.

afflictions.name: Heatstroke
afflictions.desc: The heat's got into your head. Get out of the sun and drink.

afflictions.name: Grave wound
afflictions.desc: Down and bleeding out. Bandage it within six hours or they die; stitch it too and they'll heal.

treatments.name: Clean the wound
treatments.desc: Spirits, or a yarrow poultice, or at a pinch two drinks of water.

treatments.name: Bandage it
treatments.desc: Bind it tight with clean linen.

treatments.name: Stitch it
treatments.desc: Needle and thread. Grit your teeth.

treatments.name: Splint it
treatments.desc: A splint, or a split log and a bandage to make one.

weathers.name: Drizzle
weathers.desc: A fine wet mist of rain that gets into everything.

weathers.name: Storm
weathers.desc: Driving rain and a gale. Get under a roof.

weathers.name: Warm spell
weathers.desc: A hot, still day, rare on this coast.

origins.name: The Loran coast
origins.desc: You grew up in a fishing village a few days down this same coast, mending nets and gutting herring. The sea's in your blood, whatever it did to your boat.
origins.perkDesc: Coast folk know their own: Yenson and Tam start out as friends, and you can talk boats and weather with them.

origins.name: The northern woods
origins.desc: You were raised in a charcoal-burners' camp deep in the forests of northern Loran, where the nearest neighbour was a day's walk and the wolves were closer.
origins.perkDesc: You start with Hunting at level 1, and Ida and Rook take you for one of their own sooner.

origins.name: Zaron, the capital
origins.desc: You grew up in the crowded streets under King Melvin's palace, when Melvin was still a king people cheered for.
origins.perkDesc: No market trader has ever fleeced you: shop prices are 10% better. Some country folk don't care for a Zaron accent.

origins.name: Laurasia, over the sea
origins.desc: You're not from Loran at all. You came from the continent of Laurasia, on the boat that sank, to find work or to get away from something.
origins.perkDesc: +1 Intellect from seeing the world, but everyone in Loran starts out a little warier of a foreigner.

quirks.name: Thick-blooded
quirks.up: Cold and rain get to you 30% slower
